episodes.title: Den mystiske Miu
episodes.summary: Miu's arrival at an Eastern European family's home introduces her to a dark, Copenhagen underworld exploiting undocumented immigrants.

episodes.title: Hævn er mit navn
episodes.summary: Rosella sends Miu away after doubting her powers. While out on the street, Miu's ability comes into play when she sees a woman about to give birth.

episodes.title: Dragon Palace
episodes.summary: Miu accompanies Mother Hulda to the estate of a wealthy family, where she has a troubling vision about someone she was close to in the past.

episodes.title: Kærlig hilsen Mr. Chiang
episodes.summary: Upon returning to help alleviate Mr. Chiang's migraines, Miu strikes a dangerous deal that forces her to reconnect with an old associate.

episodes.title: Copenhagen
episodes.summary: A brutal gang war may create an opportunity for Miu. After suffering severe injuries, Nicklas summons a secret weapon to carry out his revenge.

episodes.title: Himlen vil falde
episodes.summary: As Miu learns the truth behind Mother Hulda's story, a threatening presence prepares to destroy everything she has worked for.
